description: This file defines a VariadicExpression class used within the Twig templating engine, specifically for handling variadic expressions in template parsing.

classes.name: VariadicExpression
classes.description: A class representing a variadic expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, extending ArrayExpression and customizing compilation to handle variadic arguments.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the variadic expression, outputting the variadic operator '...' followed by the array expression compilation.
